entries.cmd: oc create deployment stubborn --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi-minimal:latest -- sh -c 'sleep infinity' >/dev/null && oc create deployment polite --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi-minimal:latest -- sh -c 'trap "exit 0" TERM; sleep infinity & wait' >/dev/null && oc rollout status deployment/stubborn --timeout=180s >/dev/null && oc rollout status deployment/polite --timeout=180s >/dev/null && for app in stubborn polite; do echo "$app: PID 1 is $(oc exec deploy/$app -- cat /proc/1/cmdline | tr '\0' ' ')"; done
